// js/main.js
import { state } from './state.js';
import { preloadStaticIcons, startLoadingProcess } from './data/loader.js';

import { initFilterEvents, openCountryFilterMenu } from './features/filter.js';
import { initLeaderboardEvents, closeLeaderboard, renderPlayerLeaderboard } from './features/leaderboard.js';
import { initPlayerProfileEvents, closePlayerProfile, openPlayerProfile, checkInitialPlayerRoute } from './features/playerProfile.js';
import { initRankingEvents, switchCategory, renderRankingList, showRankingScreen } from './features/ranking.js';
import { initCupCards, resetCard } from './features/cupCards.js';
import { initVideoModalEvents, openVideoModal } from './ui/videoModal.js';

// 後方互換性のため window に公開 (既存の loader.js 等の呼び出しに対応)
window.switchCategory = switchCategory;
window.checkInitialPlayerRoute = checkInitialPlayerRoute;

// フィルター変更時の再描画コールバック
window.onFilterChange = () => {
  if (state.leaderboardActive) renderPlayerLeaderboard();
  if (!document.getElementById('ranking-screen').classList.contains('hidden')) renderRankingList();
};

function initGlobalEvents() {
  window.addEventListener('open-country-filter', openCountryFilterMenu);
  
  window.addEventListener('jump-to-course', (e) => {
    switchCategory(e.detail.cat);
    setTimeout(() => showRankingScreen(e.detail.course), 50);
  });

  document.querySelector('.close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (state.playerProfileActive) closePlayerProfile();
    else if (state.leaderboardActive) closeLeaderboard();
    else resetCard();
  });

  // 動的イベント委譲: ランキング一覧
  document.getElementById('rankingList').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const nameLink = e.target.closest('.name-link[data-player]');
    if (nameLink) { e.preventDefault(); openPlayerProfile(nameLink.dataset.player, nameLink); return; }
    const videoIcon = e.target.closest('.video-icon[data-video-url]');
    if (videoIcon) { openVideoModal(videoIcon.dataset.videoUrl); return; }
  });

  // 動的イベント委譲: プレイヤーリーダーボード
  document.getElementById('playerRankingList').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const nameLink = e.target.closest('.name-link[data-player]');
    if (nameLink) { e.preventDefault(); openPlayerProfile(nameLink.dataset.player, nameLink); return; }
    const row = e.target.closest('.player-row[data-player]');
    if (row) { openPlayerProfile(row.dataset.player, row); return; }
  });
}

// ===== 初期化 =====
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initCupCards();
  initFilterEvents();
  initLeaderboardEvents();
  initPlayerProfileEvents();
  initRankingEvents();
  initVideoModalEvents();
  initGlobalEvents();
  
  preloadStaticIcons();
  startLoadingProcess();
  checkInitialPlayerRoute();
});

import { state } from '../state.js';
import { countryMatchesFilter, openCountryFilterMenu } from './filter.js';
import { escapeAttr, getRankImageSrc } from '../utils/dom.js';

export function renderPlayerLeaderboard() {
  const listEl = document.getElementById('playerRankingList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '';
  const filteredData = state.playerLeaderboardData.filter(p => countryMatchesFilter(state.globalPlayerCountryMap[p.name]));
  
  filteredData.forEach((p, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = `player-row ${p.rank === 1 ? 'rank-1st' : ''} animate-slide-in`;
    row.style.animationDelay = `${Math.min(i + 1, 20) * 0.03}s`;
    row.dataset.player = p.name;

    let rankContent;

    if (p.rank <= 8) {
      rankContent = `<img src="${getRankImageSrc(p.rank)}" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.parentElement.innerText='${p.rank}'">`;
    } else {
      rankContent = `${p.rank}`;
    }

    row.innerHTML = `
      <div class="pr-rank">${rankContent}</div>
      <div class="pr-name"><a href="/player/${encodeURIComponent(p.name)}" class="name-link" data-player="${escapeAttr(p.name)}">${p.name}</a></div>
      <div class="pr-points">${p.points} pt</div>
    `;
    listEl.appendChild(row);
  });
}

export function openLeaderboard() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('leaderboard-btn');
  const panel = document.getElementById('leaderboard-panel');
  const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  state.cardRects.set('leaderboard-panel', rect);

  panel.classList.remove('hidden');
  panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:${rect.top}px; left:${rect.left}px; width:${rect.width}px; height:${rect.height}px; margin:0;`;
  document.body.classList.add('mode-expanded');
  state.leaderboardActive = true;
  renderPlayerLeaderboard();

  setTimeout(() => {
    panel.classList.add('active-panel');
    panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:50%; left:50%; width:min(700px, 92vw); height:min(80vh, 750px); transform:translate(-50%, -50%); margin:0;`;
  }, 10);
}

export function closeLeaderboard() {
  const panel = document.getElementById('leaderboard-panel');
  const rect = state.cardRects.get('leaderboard-panel');
  panel.classList.remove('active-panel');
  document.body.classList.remove('mode-expanded');
  panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:${rect.top}px; left:${rect.left}px; width:${rect.width}px; height:${rect.height}px; margin:0;`;

  setTimeout(() => {
    panel.style.cssText = '';
    panel.classList.add('hidden');
    state.leaderboardActive = false;
  }, 600);
}

export function initLeaderboardEvents() {
  document.getElementById('leaderboard-btn').addEventListener('click', openLeaderboard);
  document.querySelector('#leaderboard-panel .panel-close-btn').addEventListener('click', closeLeaderboard);
  document.querySelector('#leaderboard-panel .earth-btn').addEventListener('click', openCountryFilterMenu);
}

import { state } from '../state.js';
import { RAW_CSV_DATA, GLITCH_COURSES } from '../data/courses.js';
import { escapeAttr } from '../utils/dom.js';
import { FLAG_BASE_URL } from '../config.js';
import { countryMatchesFilter } from './filter.js';
import { getVideoIcon, isModalVideoIcon, NO_VIDEO_ICON } from '../ui/videoModal.js';
import { getRankImageSrc } from '../utils/dom.js';

export function switchCategory(cat) {
  let key = (cat === '200cc' || cat === 'Shroomless') ? 'Default' : cat;
  if (state.allCategoryData[key]) {
    state.globalRankingData = state.allCategoryData[key];
    if (state.currentSelectedCourse) renderRankingList();
  } else {
    console.warn("Data not ready for " + key);
  }
}

export function showRankingScreen(c) {
  state.currentSelectedCourse = c;
  state.currentTire = 'without';
  state.isGlitch = false;
  state.isReadMoreExpanded = false;
  updateToggleUI();

  document.body.classList.remove('mode-expanded');
  document.getElementById('cup-select-screen').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('ranking-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('ranking-course-title').innerText = c.name;

  const glitchBtn = document.getElementById('glitch-btn');
  glitchBtn.classList.toggle('hidden', !GLITCH_COURSES.includes(c.name));

  renderRankingList();
  window.scrollTo(0, 0);
}

export function goBackToCups() {
  document.getElementById('ranking-screen').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('cup-select-screen').classList.remove('hidden');
  state.currentSelectedCourse = null;
  if (state.activeCard) document.body.classList.add('mode-expanded');
}

export function toggleMode() {
  state.currentTire = (state.currentTire === 'without') ? 'dekatire' : 'without';
  updateToggleUI();
  renderRankingList();
}

export function toggleGlitchMode() {
  state.isGlitch = !state.isGlitch;
  updateToggleUI();
  renderRankingList();
}

export function toggleReadMore() {
  state.isReadMoreExpanded = true;
  renderRankingList();
}

function updateToggleUI() {
  const optWithout = document.getElementById('opt-without');
  const optDekatire = document.getElementById('opt-dekatire');
  const btnGlitch = document.getElementById('glitch-btn');

  optWithout.classList.remove('selected');
  optDekatire.classList.remove('selected');
  btnGlitch.classList.remove('active');

  if (state.currentTire === 'without') optWithout.classList.add('selected');
  else optDekatire.classList.add('selected');

  if (state.isGlitch) btnGlitch.classList.add('active');
}

export function renderRankingList() {
  const listEl = document.getElementById('rankingList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '';

  let key = state.currentSelectedCourse.file.substring(4);
  if (state.isGlitch) key += "_G";

  let data = state.globalRankingData[key] ? (state.globalRankingData[key][state.currentTire] || []) : [];
  data = data.filter(d => countryMatchesFilter(d.country));

  const displayCount = state.isReadMoreExpanded ? data.length : 8;

  for (let i = 0; i < displayCount; i++) {
    const d = data[i] || (i < 8 ? { rank: i+1, name: "---", time: "--:--", video: "-", country: "-" } : null);
    if (!d) continue;

    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = `rank-row ${d.rank === 1 ? 'rank-1st' : ''} animate-slide-in`;
    row.style.animationDelay = `${(i+1)*0.04}s`;

    const iconSrc = getVideoIcon(d.video);
   
    const hasVid = d.video !== '-' &&
               d.video !== '' &&
               iconSrc !== NO_VIDEO_ICON;

    let flagHtml = '';
    if (d.country && d.country !== '-') {
      const countryCode = d.country.toLowerCase();
      flagHtml = `<img src="${countryCode === 'scotland' ? 'img/flag/scotland.webp' : `${FLAG_BASE_URL}${countryCode}.svg`}" onerror="this.style.visibility='hidden'">`;
    }
    const nameHtml = d.name !== '---' ? `<a href="/player/${encodeURIComponent(d.name)}" class="name-link" data-player="${escapeAttr(d.name)}">${d.name}</a>` : d.name;
    const timeHtml = hasVid ? `<a href="${escapeAttr(d.video)}" target="_blank" class="time-link">${d.time}</a>` : d.time;
    let rankContent;
    if (d.rank <= 8) {
      rankContent = `<img src="${getRankImageSrc(d.rank)}" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.parentElement.innerText='${d.rank}'">`;
    } else {
      rankContent = `<span style="font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:bold;">${d.rank}</span>`;
    }
    const isModalTarget = isModalVideoIcon(iconSrc);

    const iconHtml = hasVid
      ? (isModalTarget
        ? `<div class="video-icon" data-video-url="${escapeAttr(d.video)}" style="cursor:pointer"><img src="${iconSrc}"></div>`
        : `<a href="${escapeAttr(d.video)}" target="_blank"><img src="${iconSrc}"></a>`)
      : `<div class="no-link"><img src="${NO_VIDEO_ICON}"></div>`;
    row.innerHTML = `<div class="section col-rank">${rankContent}</div><div class="section col-name">${nameHtml}</div><div class="section col-time">${timeHtml}</div><div class="section col-icon">${iconHtml}</div><div class="section col-flag">${flagHtml}</div>`;
    listEl.appendChild(row);
  }

  if (!state.isReadMoreExpanded && data.length > 8) {
    const btn = document.createElement('div');
    btn.className = 'read-more-btn animate-slide-in';
    btn.innerText = '▼ Load more ▼';
    btn.onclick = toggleReadMore;
    listEl.appendChild(btn);
  }
}

export function initRankingEvents() {
  document.querySelector('#ranking-screen .back-btn').addEventListener('click', goBackToCups);
  document.querySelector('#ranking-screen .mode-toggle').addEventListener('click', toggleMode);
  document.getElementById('glitch-btn').addEventListener('click', toggleGlitchMode);
  document.querySelector('#ranking-screen .earth-btn').addEventListener('click', () => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-country-filter')));
  document.querySelector('#ranking-screen .mobile-category-btn').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('mobile-category-overlay').classList.add('visible'));

  document.querySelector('.capsule').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const item = e.target.closest('.capsule-item[data-cat]');
    if (item) switchCategory(item.dataset.cat);
  });

  const mobileCatOverlay = document.getElementById('mobile-category-overlay');
  mobileCatOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => mobileCatOverlay.classList.remove('visible'));
  mobileCatOverlay.querySelector('.mobile-category-list').addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  mobileCatOverlay.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-item[data-cat]').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => { switchCategory(item.dataset.cat); mobileCatOverlay.classList.remove('visible'); });
  });
}

// js/ui/videoModal.js

export const NO_VIDEO_ICON = 'img/favicon/novideo.webp';

export function getVideoIcon(url) {
  if (!url || url === '-') return 'NO_VIDEO_ICON';
  const l = url.toLowerCase();
  if (l.includes('youtube') || l.includes('youtu.be') || l.includes('archive')) return 'img/favicon/youtube.webp';
  if (l.includes('twitter') || l.includes('x.com')) return 'img/favicon/x.webp';
  if (l.includes('d.kuku.lu')) return 'img/favicon/filenow.webp';
  if (l.includes('discord')) return 'img/favicon/discord.webp';
  return 'NO_VIDEO_ICON';
}

export function isModalVideoIcon(iconSrc) {
  return iconSrc.includes('youtube.webp') || 
         iconSrc.includes('discord.webp') || 
         iconSrc.includes('filenow.webp');
}

export function openVideoModal(url) {
  const youtubeFrame = document.getElementById('youtube-frame');
  const modalImage = document.getElementById('modal-image');
  const modalVideo = document.getElementById('modal-video');
  const videoModal = document.getElementById('video-modal');

  youtubeFrame.style.display = 'none'; youtubeFrame.src = "";
  modalImage.style.display = 'none'; modalImage.src = "";
  modalVideo.style.display = 'none'; modalVideo.src = "";

  if (url.toLowerCase().includes('archive')) {
    modalVideo.src = url;
    modalVideo.style.display = 'block';
    videoModal.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }

  let vid = null;
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (u.hostname === 'youtu.be') vid = u.pathname.slice(1);
    else if (u.hostname.includes('youtube')) {
      vid = u.searchParams.get('v');
      if (!vid) {
        const shortsMatch = u.pathname.match(/\/shorts\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
        if (shortsMatch) vid = shortsMatch[1];
      }
    }
  } catch(e){}
  
  if (vid) { 
    youtubeFrame.src = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${vid}?autoplay=1`; 
    youtubeFrame.style.display = 'block';
    videoModal.classList.add('visible'); 
    return;
  }

  if (url.match(/\.(mp4|webm|mov|mkv)(\?.*)?$/i)) {
    modalVideo.src = url;
    modalVideo.style.display = 'block';
    videoModal.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }

  if (url.includes('cdn.discordapp.com') || url.match(/\.(jpeg|jpg|gif|png|webp)(\?.*)?$/i)) {
    modalImage.src = url;
    modalImage.style.display = 'block';
    videoModal.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }

  window.open(url, '_blank');
}

export function closeVideoModal() { 
  const videoModal = document.getElementById('video-modal');
  videoModal.classList.remove('visible'); 
  setTimeout(() => { 
    document.getElementById('youtube-frame').src = ""; 
    document.getElementById('modal-image').src = "";
    const mv = document.getElementById('modal-video');
    mv.pause(); mv.src = "";
  }, 300); 
}

export function initVideoModalEvents() {
  const videoModal = document.getElementById('video-modal');
  videoModal.addEventListener('click', closeVideoModal);
  videoModal.querySelector('.modal-content').addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  videoModal.querySelector('.close-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', closeVideoModal);
}

import { state } from '../state.js';
import { REGION_DATA, SELECTABLE_REGIONS, COUNTRY_TO_REGION } from '../data/regions.js';
import { FLAG_BASE_URL } from '../config.js';

export function countryMatchesFilter(countryCode) {
  if (state.countryFilter.type === 'all') return true;
  if (!countryCode || countryCode === '-') return false;
  const code = countryCode.toLowerCase();
  if (state.countryFilter.type === 'country') {
    if (state.countryFilter.value === 'uk' && code === 'scotland') return true;
    return code === state.countryFilter.value;
  }
  if (state.countryFilter.type === 'region') return COUNTRY_TO_REGION[code] === state.countryFilter.value;
  return true;
}

export function openCountryFilterMenu() {
  document.getElementById('country-filter-overlay').classList.add('visible');
  showRegionList();
}

function closeCountryFilterMenu() {
  document.getElementById('country-filter-overlay').classList.remove('visible');
}

function showRegionList() {
  document.getElementById('cf-title').innerText = 'Filter by Region';
  document.getElementById('cf-back-btn').classList.remove('visible');
  const list = document.getElementById('cf-list');
  list.innerHTML = '';

  const allItem = document.createElement('div');
  allItem.className = 'cf-item all-item' + (state.countryFilter.type === 'all' ? ' selected' : '');
  allItem.innerText = 'All Regions';
  allItem.onclick = () => applyCountryFilter('all', null);
  list.appendChild(allItem);

  SELECTABLE_REGIONS.forEach(region => {
    const isSelected = state.countryFilter.type === 'region' && state.countryFilter.value === region;
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'cf-item' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '');
    item.innerText = region;
    item.onclick = () => showCountryList(region);
    list.appendChild(item);
  });
}

function showCountryList(region) {
  document.getElementById('cf-title').innerText = region;
  document.getElementById('cf-back-btn').classList.add('visible');
  const list = document.getElementById('cf-list');
  list.innerHTML = '';

  const allItem = document.createElement('div');
  allItem.className = 'cf-item all-item' + (state.countryFilter.type === 'region' && state.countryFilter.value === region ? ' selected' : '');
  allItem.innerText = `All of ${region}`;
  allItem.onclick = () => applyCountryFilter('region', region);
  list.appendChild(allItem);

  REGION_DATA[region].forEach(c => {
    const isSelected = state.countryFilter.type === 'country' && state.countryFilter.value === c.code;
    const flagSrc = c.code === 'scotland' ? 'Scotland.webp' : `${FLAG_BASE_URL}${c.code}.svg`;
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'cf-item' + (isSelected ? ' selected' : '');
    item.innerHTML = `<img src="${flagSrc}" onerror="this.style.visibility='hidden'">${c.name}`;
    item.onclick = () => applyCountryFilter('country', c.code);
    list.appendChild(item);
  });
}

export function applyCountryFilter(type, value) {
  state.countryFilter = { type, value };
  closeCountryFilterMenu();
  updateCountryFilterButtonState();
  if (window.onFilterChange) window.onFilterChange();
}

function updateCountryFilterButtonState() {
  const active = state.countryFilter.type !== 'all';
  document.querySelectorAll('.earth-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('filter-active', active));
}

export function initFilterEvents() {
  const cfOverlay = document.getElementById('country-filter-overlay');
  cfOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('country-filter-overlay').classList.remove('visible'));
  cfOverlay.querySelector('.country-filter-box').addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  document.getElementById('cf-back-btn').addEventListener('click', showRegionList);
  cfOverlay.querySelector('.cf-close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('country-filter-overlay').classList.remove('visible'));
}

import { state } from '../state.js';
import { RAW_CSV_DATA } from '../data/courses.js';
import { escapeAttr, getRankImageSrc } from '../utils/dom.js';
import {
  getVideoIcon,
  isModalVideoIcon,
  NO_VIDEO_ICON
} from '../ui/videoModal.js';

export function getPlayerCourseRows(name, catKey) {
  let key = (catKey === '200cc' || catKey === 'Shroomless') ? 'Default' : catKey;
  const categoryData = state.allCategoryData[key] || {};

  return RAW_CSV_DATA.map(course => {
    const trackKey = course.file.substring(4);
    const trackData = categoryData[trackKey];
    const entry = trackData ? (trackData.without || []).find(e => e.name === name) : null;
    return {
      trackName: course.name, course,
      rank: entry ? entry.rank : null,
      time: entry ? entry.time : null,
      video: entry ? entry.video : null,
    };
  });
}

export function renderPlayerProfileRecords() {
  let rows = getPlayerCourseRows(state.currentProfileName, state.currentProfileCategory);
  if (state.currentProfileSortMode === 'rank') {
    rows = [...rows].sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.rank === null && b.rank === null) return 0;
      if (a.rank === null) return 1;
      if (b.rank === null) return -1;
      return a.rank - b.rank;
    });
  }

  const listEl = document.getElementById('ppRecordList');
  listEl.innerHTML = '';

  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const hasRecord = r.rank !== null;
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = `record-row ${hasRecord && r.rank === 1 ? 'gold-rank' : ''} animate-slide-in`;
    row.style.animationDelay = `${Math.min(i + 1, 25) * 0.02}s`;

    let rankContent = hasRecord ? (r.rank <= 8 ? `<img src="${getRankImageSrc(r.rank)}" onerror="this.style.display='none';this.parentElement.innerText='${r.rank}'">` : `${r.rank}`) : '-';
    let iconHtml = `<img src="${NO_VIDEO_ICON}">`;
    let timeHtml = hasRecord ? r.time : '-';

    if (hasRecord && r.video && r.video !== '-') {
      const iconSrc = getVideoIcon(r.video);
      const isModalTarget = isModalVideoIcon(iconSrc);
      const safeHref = escapeAttr(String(r.video));
      timeHtml = `<a href="${safeHref}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="time-link">${r.time}</a>`;
      iconHtml = isModalTarget 
        ? `<div class="video-icon" data-video-url="${safeHref}" style="cursor:pointer"><img src="${iconSrc}" onerror="this.src='${NO_VIDEO_ICON}'"></div>`
        : `<a href="${safeHref}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="${iconSrc}" onerror="this.src='Novideo.webp'"></a>`;
    }

    row.innerHTML = `<div class="rr-rank">${rankContent}</div><div class="rr-track course-jump">${r.trackName}</div><div class="rr-time">${timeHtml}</div><div class="rr-icon">${iconHtml}</div>`;
    row.querySelector('.rr-track').addEventListener('click', () => jumpToCourseFromProfile(r.course));
    listEl.appendChild(row);
  });
}

export function jumpToCourseFromProfile(course) {
  closePlayerProfile(true);
  // 循環参照を避けるためカスタムイベントで main.js に処理を委譲
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jump-to-course', { detail: { course, cat: state.currentProfileCategory } }));
}

export function switchProfileCategory(cat) {
  state.currentProfileCategory = cat;
  document.querySelectorAll('.pp-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('selected', t.dataset.cat === cat));
  renderPlayerProfileRecords();
}

export function setProfileSortMode(mode) {
  state.currentProfileSortMode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('.sort-toggle-option').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('selected', el.dataset.sort === mode));
  renderPlayerProfileRecords();
}

export function openPlayerProfile(name, originEl, pushState = true) {
  if (state.leaderboardActive) {
    const panel = document.getElementById('leaderboard-panel');
    panel.classList.remove('active-panel', 'hidden');
    panel.style.cssText = '';
    state.leaderboardActive = false;
  }

  state.currentProfileName = name;
  state.currentProfileCategory = 'General';
  state.currentProfileSortMode = 'course';
  
  const channelUrl = state.globalPlayerChannelMap[name];
  const ppNameEl = document.getElementById('pp-name');
  ppNameEl.innerHTML = channelUrl ? `<a href="${channelUrl.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="name-link">${name}</a>` : name;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.pp-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.toggle('selected', t.dataset.cat === 'General'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.sort-toggle-option').forEach(el => el.classList.toggle('selected', el.dataset.sort === 'course'));

  const panel = document.getElementById('player-profile-panel');
  panel.classList.remove('hidden');
  
  if (originEl) {
    const rect = originEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    state.cardRects.set('player-profile-panel', rect);
    panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; margin:0; top:${rect.top}px; left:${rect.left}px; width:${rect.width}px; height:${rect.height}px; opacity:1;`;
  } else {
    state.cardRects.delete('player-profile-panel');
    panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; margin:0; top:50%; left:50%; width:min(700px, 92vw); height:min(80vh, 750px); transform:translate(-50%, -50%); opacity:0;`;
  }

  document.body.classList.add('mode-expanded');
  state.playerProfileActive = true;
  renderPlayerProfileRecords();

  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      panel.classList.add('active-panel');
      panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; margin:0; top:50%; left:50%; width:min(700px, 92vw); height:min(80vh, 750px); transform:translate(-50%, -50%); opacity:1;`;
    }, 10);
  });

  if (pushState) history.pushState({ player: name }, '', '/player/' + encodeURIComponent(name));
}

export function closePlayerProfile(skipHistory) {
  const panel = document.getElementById('player-profile-panel');
  const rect = state.cardRects.get('player-profile-panel');
  panel.classList.remove('active-panel');
  document.body.classList.remove('mode-expanded');

  if (rect) {
    panel.style.cssText = `position:fixed; margin:0; top:${rect.top}px; left:${rect.left}px; width:${rect.width}px; height:${rect.height}px;`;
  } else {
    panel.style.opacity = '0';
  }

  setTimeout(() => {
    panel.style.cssText = '';
    panel.classList.add('hidden');
    state.playerProfileActive = false;
  }, 600);

  if (!skipHistory) history.pushState({}, '', '/');
}

export function checkInitialPlayerRoute() {
  const match = window.location.pathname.match(/^\/player\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
  if (match) openPlayerProfile(decodeURIComponent(match[1]), null, false);
}

export function initPlayerProfileEvents() {
  window.addEventListener('popstate', () => {
    const match = window.location.pathname.match(/^\/player\/([^\/]+)\/?$/);
    if (match) {
      const name = decodeURIComponent(match[1]);
      if (!(state.playerProfileActive && state.currentProfileName === name)) openPlayerProfile(name, null, false);
    } else if (state.playerProfileActive) {
      closePlayerProfile(true);
    }
  });

  document.querySelector('#player-profile-panel .panel-close-btn').addEventListener('click', () => closePlayerProfile());
  document.querySelector('#player-profile-panel .pp-mobile-btn').addEventListener('click', () => document.getElementById('profile-mobile-category-overlay').classList.add('visible'));
  
  const profileMobileOverlay = document.getElementById('profile-mobile-category-overlay');
  profileMobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', () => profileMobileOverlay.classList.remove('visible'));
  profileMobileOverlay.querySelector('.mobile-category-list').addEventListener('click', (e) => e.stopPropagation());
  profileMobileOverlay.querySelectorAll('.mobile-category-item[data-cat]').forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener('click', () => { switchProfileCategory(item.dataset.cat); profileMobileOverlay.classList.remove('visible'); });
  });

  document.getElementById('pp-tabs').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const tab = e.target.closest('.pp-tab[data-cat]');
    if (tab) switchProfileCategory(tab.dataset.cat);
  });

  document.getElementById('pp-sort-toggle').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    const opt = e.target.closest('.sort-toggle-option[data-sort]');
    if (opt) setProfileSortMode(opt.dataset.sort);
  });
}

// js/features/cupCards.js の先頭部分をこう書き換えてください
import { state } from '../state.js';
import { RAW_CSV_DATA } from '../data/courses.js'; // ← ここを修正
import { COURSES_PER_CUP, ICON_BASE_PATH, SCALE_FACTOR, SIDEBAR_WIDTH } from '../config.js';
import { showRankingScreen } from './ranking.js';

// ... 以下は変更なし ...

export function expandCard(card) {
  const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
  state.cardRects.set(card.id, rect);
  
  state.placeholderEl = document.createElement('div');
  state.placeholderEl.className = 'cup-card-placeholder';
  state.placeholderEl.style.width = rect.width + 'px';
  state.placeholderEl.style.height = rect.height + 'px';
  state.placeholderEl.onclick = resetCard;
  
  card.parentNode.insertBefore(state.placeholderEl, card);
  card.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:${rect.top}px; left:${rect.left}px; width:${rect.width}px; height:${rect.height}px; margin:0;`;
  document.body.classList.add('mode-expanded');
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    card.classList.add('active');
    card.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:50%; left:50%; width:${rect.width * SCALE_FACTOR + SIDEBAR_WIDTH + 50}px; height:${rect.height * SCALE_FACTOR + 25}px; transform:translate(-50%, -50%); margin:0;`;
    state.activeCard = card;
  }, 10);
}

export function resetCard() {
  if (!state.activeCard) return;
  const c = state.activeCard;
  const r = state.cardRects.get(c.id);
  c.classList.remove('active');
  document.body.classList.remove('mode-expanded');
  c.style.cssText = `position:fixed; top:${r.top}px; left:${r.left}px; width:${r.width}px; height:${r.height}px;`;
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    c.style.cssText = '';
    if (state.placeholderEl) { state.placeholderEl.remove(); state.placeholderEl = null; }
    state.activeCard = null;
  }, 600);
}

export function initCupCards() {
  const container = document.getElementById('cupsContainer');
  RAW_CSV_DATA.forEach((course, i) => {
    if (i % COURSES_PER_CUP === 0) {
      const cupIdx = i / COURSES_PER_CUP;
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'cup-card';
      card.id = `card-${i}`;
      card.onclick = () => { if (!card.classList.contains('active')) expandCard(card); };
      
      const grid = document.createElement('div');
      grid.className = 'course-grid';
      RAW_CSV_DATA.slice(i, i + COURSES_PER_CUP).forEach(c => {
        const w = document.createElement('div');
        w.className = 'course-img-wrapper';
        w.onclick = (e) => { 
          if (card.classList.contains('active')) { 
            e.stopPropagation(); 
            showRankingScreen(c); 
          } 
        };
        w.innerHTML = `<img src="img/trackImage/${c.file}.webp" loading="lazy" decoding="async" onerror="this.style.display='none'">`;
        grid.appendChild(w);
      });
      
      const icon = document.createElement('div');
      icon.className = 'cup-icon-wrapper';
      icon.innerHTML = `<img src="${ICON_BASE_PATH}${cupIdx + 9}.webp" loading="lazy" decoding="async">`;
      card.append(grid, icon);
      container.appendChild(card);
    }
  });
}

// js/data/loader.js

import {
  SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY, CSV_URLS,
  PLAYER_LEADERBOARD_CSV_URL, STATIC_ICONS,
} from '../config.js';
import { parseRankingCsv, parsePlayerLeaderboardCsv } from './parser.js';

// 進捗管理用の状態（このモジュール内で完結）
let loadedAssets = 0;
const totalImages = STATIC_ICONS.length;
const totalCsvs = Object.keys(CSV_URLS).length + 1 + 1;
const totalAssets = totalImages + totalCsvs;

function updateProgress() {
  loadedAssets++;
  const percent = Math.min((loadedAssets / totalAssets) * 100, 100);
  document.getElementById('progress-bar').style.width = percent + '%';
  
  if (loadedAssets >= totalAssets) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('loading-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    }, 500);
  }
}

export function preloadStaticIcons() {
  STATIC_ICONS.forEach(src => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = updateProgress;
    img.onerror = updateProgress;
    img.src = src;
  });
}

export function buildPlayerChannelMap(allCategoryData) {
  const map = {};
  Object.values(allCategoryData).forEach(categoryData => {
    Object.values(categoryData).forEach(track => {
      ['without', 'dekatire'].forEach(mode => {
        (track[mode] || []).forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.name && entry.channel && entry.channel !== '-') {
            map[entry.name] = entry.channel;
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
  return map;
}

export function buildPlayerCountryMap(allCategoryData) {
  const map = {};
  Object.values(allCategoryData).forEach(categoryData => {
    Object.values(categoryData).forEach(track => {
      ['without', 'dekatire'].forEach(mode => {
        (track[mode] || []).forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.name && entry.country && entry.country !== '-') {
            map[entry.name] = entry.country.toLowerCase();
          }
        });
      });
    });
  });
  return map;
}

// allCategoryData / playerLeaderboardData / switchCategory / checkInitialPlayerRoute は
// main.js 側の状態・UIを参照するため、window 経由で受け取る（Step 5 までの暫定）
export async function startLoadingProcess() {
  const allCategoryData = window.allCategoryData;
  let playerLeaderboardData = window.playerLeaderboardData;

  // Default / Flap / Mission はCSVから取得
  const csvPromises = Object.keys(CSV_URLS).map(async (key) => {
    const url = CSV_URLS[key];
    try {
      const res = await fetch(url + "&t=" + Date.now());
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to load ${key}`);
      const text = await res.text();
      allCategoryData[key] = parseRankingCsv(text);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
      allCategoryData[key] = {};
    } finally {
      updateProgress();
    }
  });

  // General は Supabase から取得
  const supabasePromise = (async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        SUPABASE_URL + '/rest/v1/times?category=eq.General&order=track_name,rank&limit=5000',
        {
          headers: {
            'apikey': SUPABASE_KEY,
            'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + SUPABASE_KEY,
          }
        }
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load General from Supabase');
      const rows = await res.json();

      const generalData = {};
      for (const row of rows) {
        const track = String(row.track_name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (!generalData[track]) {
          generalData[track] = { without: [], dekatire: [] };
        }
        generalData[track]['without'].push({
          rank:    row.rank,
          name:    row.player,
          time:    row.time    || '-',
          video:   row.video   || '-',
          channel: row.channel || '-',
          country: row.country || '-',
        });
      }
      allCategoryData['General'] = generalData;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
      allCategoryData['General'] = {};
    } finally {
      updateProgress();
    }
  })();

  // プレイヤーリーダーボードは公開CSV(K:M列)から取得
  const playerLeaderboardPromise = (async () => {
    if (!PLAYER_LEADERBOARD_CSV_URL) {
      console.warn('PLAYER_LEADERBOARD_CSV_URL is not set, using fallback data.');
      updateProgress();
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res = await fetch(PLAYER_LEADERBOARD_CSV_URL + "&t=" + Date.now());
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load player leaderboard CSV');
      const text = await res.text();
      const parsed = parsePlayerLeaderboardCsv(text);
      if (parsed.length > 0) {
        window.playerLeaderboardData = parsed;
        playerLeaderboardData = parsed;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn(e);
    } finally {
      updateProgress();
    }
  })();

  await Promise.all([...csvPromises, supabasePromise, playerLeaderboardPromise]);

  // 記録データが揃ったので、プレイヤーリーダーボードの名前にチャンネルURL・国を紐付ける
  window.globalPlayerChannelMap = buildPlayerChannelMap(allCategoryData);
  window.globalPlayerCountryMap = buildPlayerCountryMap(allCategoryData);
  window.playerLeaderboardData.forEach(p => { p.link = window.globalPlayerChannelMap[p.name] || null; });

  window.switchCategory('General');
  window.checkInitialPlayerRoute();
}

export function escapeAttr(s) {
  return String(s)
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;");
}

const RANK_SUFFIX = {
  1: "st",
  2: "nd",
  3: "rd"
};

export function getRankImageSrc(rank) {
  rank = Number(rank);

  if (!Number.isInteger(rank) || rank < 1) {
    return "img/rank/1st.webp";
  }

  const suffix = RANK_SUFFIX[rank] || "th";
  return `img/rank/${rank}${suffix}.webp`;
}

export function normalizeTrackFileName(file) {
  return String(file)
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\u2018\u2019]/g, "'")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "_");
}

export function getTrackImageSrc(file) {
  return `img/trackImage/${normalizeTrackFileName(file)}.webp`;
}

// js/data/parser.js

export function parseRankingCsv(csvText) {
  const lines = csvText.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  let currentTrackKey = null;
  const resultData = {}; 

  const getCell = (val) => {
    if (!val) return '-';
    const s = val.trim();
    return s === '' ? '-' : s;
  };

  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const cells = lines[i].split(',');
    if (cells.length < 2) continue;
    
    const track = cells[0].trim();
    let mode = 'without';

    if (track && track !== '-') { 
      currentTrackKey = track; 
    } else if (currentTrackKey) { 
      mode = 'dekatire';
    } else {
      continue;
    }

    if (!resultData[currentTrackKey]) resultData[currentTrackKey] = { without: [], dekatire: [] };

    for (let r = 0; r < 100; r++) {
      const idx = 1 + (r * 5); 
      if (idx + 4 >= cells.length) break;
      const name = cells[idx] ? cells[idx].trim() : '-';
      
      if (name && name !== '-' && name !== '') {
        resultData[currentTrackKey][mode].push({
          rank: r + 1,
          name: name,
          time: getCell(cells[idx+1]),
          video: getCell(cells[idx+2]),
          channel: getCell(cells[idx+3]),
          country: getCell(cells[idx+4])
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return resultData;
}

export function parsePlayerLeaderboardCsv(csvText) {
  const lines = csvText.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
  const result = [];
  for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const cells = lines[i].split(',');
    if (cells.length < 13) continue;
    const name = cells[10] ? cells[10].trim() : '';
    const points = cells[11] ? cells[11].trim() : '';
    const rank = cells[12] ? cells[12].trim() : '';
    if (name && points !== '' && rank !== '') {
      result.push({ rank: parseInt(rank, 10), name, points: parseInt(points, 10) });
    }
  }
  return result;
